khufra: Structural response to the entire category of mobile heroes, which dominates the high ranked line.
melissa: The only shooter who solves the diving problem alone, without depending on his support.
fredrinn: Holds the front line while maintaining real damage: a jungler who forgives mistakes.
mathilda: Saves a poorly placed ally and makes up for a positioning error, which counts a lot in solo play.
yu-zhong: Wins long fights as long as the opponent does not buy healing reduction.
cecilion: End of game without ceiling, provided you get through the first fifteen minutes.
beatrix: Very high power, but the level requires mastering the choice of weapons.
tigreal: Constant and readable value; ceiling limited by the predictability of the commitment.
granger: Excellent early peak, weaker endgame than critical shooters.
paquito: Very strong in good hands, worthless if the windows are marred.
kagura: High ceiling, but punished by assassins as soon as state management slips.
estes: Dominates compositions without healing reduction; collapses as soon as it arrives.
lancelot: Solid, but Khufra's widespread presence caps his influence.
gusion: The level depends almost entirely on the player: S+ mastery, C otherwise.
chou: Excellent in a coordinated team, much less so solo where isolation is not followed.
angela: Depends on the level of the chosen ally, which makes it irregular in ranked queue.
pharsa: Punished by the number of jungle assassins currently playing.
ling: Still viable, but each opposing team now has an answer.
franco: A missed grappling hook costs an entire rotation; too irregular without vocal coordination.
belerick: Ranked at the top especially by its bans, among the most frequent in the game; his win rate is good without being exceptional, and both Lesley and Beatrix clearly hinder him.
eudora: Its place is primarily due to banning, increasing over thirty days. Reinforced in patch 2.1.88 without published details, it especially wins short games.
hirara: New heroine in patch 2.1.88, banned in the vast majority of games in Mythic Glory: the level reflects the fear she inspires, while her victory rate drops below average in Mythic.
marcel: Among the highest win rates, but in very few games played. Patch 2.1.88 removed immobilization from skill 1; Angela and Floryn remain his worst measured adversaries.
gloo: Banned about every other game and winning when it passes, despite its weakening in patch 2.1.88. Faramis is by far his clearest answer according to the measurements.
rafaela: Driven by one of the highest win rates in the game since patch 2.1.88 shortened the base recharge of his resurrection; his banishment lasts thirty days.
sun: Endgame Hero: Below average before the fourteenth minute, way above after the sixteenth. His ban is reduced over thirty days but remains high, especially in Mythic.
hanzo: The level is due to bans, increasing over thirty days, while his victory rate has fallen to below average. Patch 2.1.88 strengthened it on the turtle and the lord.
miya: The most played hero in the game, with an above average win rate at all ranks and an increasing ban over thirty days.
floryn: Very effective in short games, but his victory rate drops below average after the eighteenth minute: a tempo value more than the end of the game.
saber: Banished much more often in Mythic than in Mythic Glory for a near-average win rate. Patch 2.1.88 shifted it towards sustained damage and fighter items.
atlas: Group commitment which wins especially with support at its side, Mathilda, Floryn, Estes or Rafaela; Marcel remains by far his worst measured opponent.
masha: Very high victory rate, but over a tiny number of games: the measurement is too fragile to draw a conclusion.
kaja: Ranked high by banning alone, down sharply over thirty days; his win rate remains below average at all ranks.
minotaur: One of the best win rates among roamers, for a low ban: a safe choice, almost always available in selection.
yi-sun-shin: The most played jungler in Mythic Glory, especially effective in short games; his win rate returns to average after the twelfth minute.
hanabi: Well played and above average across all ranks, but significantly less effective in Mythic Glory and in longer games.
barats: On the rise, with selection and banning increasing over thirty days. However, its performance drops in long games, and X.Borg counters it very clearly.
lukas: Weak in short games, solid afterwards, and better in Mythic Glory than in Mythic; little banned, it often remains available.
diggie: Solid win rate but very little played, so a fragile metric. Patch 2.1.88 revised his attributes and the cost of his skills.
lolita: Almost never played: its level is based on a sample too thin to be taken literally.
minsitthar: Close to average in victories, classified by a ban which recedes over thirty days; Natalia and Yin are his most difficult opponents by measurement.
valir: Few banned and consistent: above average at all ranks and even in long games. Rafaela and Kaja are her clearest counters in Mythic Glory.
carmilla: Its effectiveness depends on the partner: its measured duos with Diggie, Floryn or Mathilda are among the strongest gaps in the game. Reinforced in patch 2.1.88, with no details published.
